crowdsec_defer_reasons: The current attested HTTP/HTTPS surface is limited to Caddy /healthz.
The backend app is not deployed yet.
Docker is present only as the protected, loopback-only RabbitMQ substrate; it does not add a public HTTP workload.
CrowdSec HTTP decisions need real backend app access logs and route behavior to avoid false positives.
The VPS should avoid extra agents until there is an application HTTP workload to protect.

event_sources: Grafana Loki security logs from auth.log, fail2ban.log, and security journal units
backend health report service-state checks for ssh, ufw, fail2ban, caddy, and alloy
maintenance_automation.blocked_event_visibility: fail2ban ban events are reported from Loki without adding IP, path, user, or request labels

http_future_sources: Cloudflare edge ranges from the provider-managed source
GitHub Actions only for documented deployment or validation callbacks
external uptime probes with documented provider names and source ranges when available
operator IPs only through a reviewed PR or protected secret-backed variable

validation.live_verification: read-only until a later approved protected apply

rollback.preferred: git revert the abuse-protection change and run protected apply
